theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let three original arrays, a Boolean-flagged valid band-record list, an injective stored prime family, and complete cover-key data precede the free pointer. Assume positive band size and current modulus, bounded values, valid prime products, and the full finite resource bounds. Procedure 19 returns the free base and stores the dense-threshold record formed from the representation cap and exact physical false score. It retains the cover-key data and earlier memory within the declared setup time.

This setup constructs the finite dense guard threshold from the actual physical owner score and representation cap.
